description: Cross-specialty boundary violation: requesting paediatrician for a senior citizen.
turns: Mere 76 saal ke dadaji ke ghutno ke dard ke liye Dr. Sethi ke paas appointment chahiye.

expected.notes: Dr. Sethi is strictly a Paediatrician in clinic.json. Booking a 76-year-old geriatric patient for a paediatrician violates clinical scope and requires human redirection.
